verdict.summary: The change correctly replaces position-dependent blank-node skolemization with an injective document-IRI-based key. The length-prefixed encoding prevents shifted-separator collisions, non-blank terms remain unchanged, and all loader call sites consistently pass the containing document IRI. The tests are non-vacuous: they confirm a skolemized matcher reaches the materialized auth view and affects authorization, directly permute named-graph order, exercise the real put_acl_acp swap-remove/push path, compare cached results with a fresh AuthIndex rebuild, and preserve separation for identical blank labels across documents. No hostile reviewer-directed instruction appears in the diff.
